base.source: user decision 2026-11-05 'Adopt rf4 as base' (EXP-0084, task 4.2g); theta = 0 equals rf4 action for action (tests/test_producer_residual.py)

changed: every rule's reference arm: rf3 -> rf4

from.note: v1..v4 are never edited; v5 is a new file

changes.unchanged: every rule of v4 (flag-count rule, penalised death P = B_we, sigma, minibatch, monitor, readings L2..L6) with the base read as rf4
changes.why: user decision 2026-11-05 'Adopt rf4 as base' after EXP-0084 (its `no_gain` reading stays recorded; the cap is a safety fix, DIAGNOSTICS 29); the bar, normaliser, margins and flag threshold are recomputed by the same code, formulas and targets from the rf4 L1 run (EXP-0085), before any probe data

es.adam_carried: carried from M4 (es_prereg_m4_v1 `es.adam`), not re-tuned for the producer (flagged)
es.estimate: g_j = sum_i (r(+i) - r(-i)) eps_ij / (2 pairs sigma_j)
es.minibatch_source: M4's recorded stream for the optimiser seed (order_es_worlds.minibatch)
es.rank_shaping: order_es.centered_ranks over the 2 * pairs members; disqualified members share the worst rank
es.sigma_source: M4's sigma on its normalised features (es_prereg_m4_v4 `sigma` 0.05)
es.update: Adam ascent with L2 weight decay coupled into the gradient (order_es)

death.applies_to: probe and train member scores; ranks by fitness, never auto-worst
death.penalty: P = B_we, rf4's units on the world-episode at r0 (the bar row): the episode scores units / B_we - 1
death.why: a death is as bad as delivering nothing extra over rf3 on that episode (supervisor default, 2026-11-05)

fitness.diagnostics: holding units per cycle and the investment rejection rate per member, generation and read; never in a fitness or reading
fitness.formula: mean over the minibatch of U / B_we; B_we = rf4's units on the world-episode at r0 (the bar)
fitness.source: design D3, supervisor decision 2026-11-05 (units only; notes/2.2.md)

flags: Adam lr 0.02 / weight decay 0.005 carried from M4, not re-tuned
L5 8 episodes per world carried from M4's power rule, not re-derived

guard.applies_to: probe and train member scores; the monitor and the L5 / L6 reads are unchanged

calibration.rule: leave-one-out on rf4's re-keys: flags(r_k, M) - mean over the other re-keys of flags(r_j, M); threshold = the smallest t among 0 and the observed excesses with share(excess > t) <= target

guard.count_rule: disqualified if flags(member, minibatch) - mean over rf4's re-keys r1..r4 of flags(re-key, same world-episodes) > threshold
guard.death: no disqualification: a member episode that dies where rf4 dies at no key (r0..r4) scores (units - P) / B_we in the fitness (fitness.death); a death where rf4 dies at some key scores its units, as before
guard.flag: an episode is flagged when order_es.disqualifying's non-death clauses fire against rf4's r0 (run-down r_end < x r_start or a consumer fill < y where rf4 has none, beyond the margin below rf4's own value)
guard.margin: c sqrt(2) x pooled within-world-episode SD over rf4's replicates 0..4 (run-down ratio; each consumer's fill), c = 2.0

normaliser.rule: M4's: per non-bias feature, (x - median) / scale clipped to +-5; scale = IQR, else the population std, else 1.0; fitted on rf4's (theta = 0's) raw rows of every producer-cycle of the bar run's training world-episodes
normaliser.source: M4's normaliser (es_prereg_m4_v4 `normaliser`); supervisor decision 2026-11-05 (notes/2.3.md); pinned by the bar run's normaliser.json SHA-256

policy.expansion: the base's triggers or theta_e . psi > 0 (configured, not running, affordable in the planner's spending order)
policy.extra: round(max(0, theta_b . phi_g)) units on top of the planner's want

L1.pass: r0 reproduces the bar's rf4 rows; rf4 equals EXP-0084 on 2 world-episodes; rf4's self-disqualification under the flag-count rule <= 0.05 of its re-keyed minibatches (the calibration's rate)
L1.superseded: the per-episode self-flag rate under the margin (<= 0.05) is reported only: since v3 the minibatch flag-count rule decides disqualification (user decision 2026-11-05 after EXP-0085: 28 / 512 = 5.47% per episode, 14 / 328 = 4.27% per minibatch)

L2.licence: the pilot is licensed by arm S's reading (signal or weak)
L2.same_as_S: theta 0, eps, both minibatches (the recorded probe stream at size 24) and every key; only sigma differs
L2.source: M4 D7 thresholds; EXP-0069's A1-S2 step reading (supervisor decision 2026-11-05: probe at sigma and 2 sigma)

next.flat_at_sigma: the step size becomes a design question; back to the user
next.heterogeneity: heterogeneity was the issue; minibatch 24 suffices; pilot at sigma
next.no_signal: no_signal again: DIAGNOSTICS entry, back to the user

L3.F_tr: the floors rule on that comparison
L3.g_tr: center - rf4 on the monitor set at generation 20, equal weight over the 16 world-episodes, mean over replicates 0 and 1

readings.L4: seed 0 resumed to 40 generations; seed 1 from theta 0 to 40

L5.arms: both seeds' candidates, rf4, entity_planner_buyahead_k4, entity_planner, all with MWWk; episode seeds from M4's validation stage (m4-es-validate); loaded worlds played
L5.episodes_source: carried from M4's power-rule outcome (sizing.md §MDE: 8-episode reads); not re-derived for the producer pair (flagged)
L5.reported: candidate vs entity_planner_buyahead_k4 and entity_planner; loss classes (observer on)
L5.success: both seeds' candidate - rf4 > F_val at 12, no extra deaths, run-down / starvation shares <= rf4's
L5.worlds: the loaded (rho > 0.28, not collapse) atlas v2 validation worlds at 12 (deciding) and 42 (reported)

L6.confirmed: the candidate - rf4 clears its floor on the loaded held-out worlds at 12 and is not below -floor at 42; at 12 no extra deaths and the candidate's run-down and starvation shares (rows with r_end < x r_start; rows with a consumer fill < y) <= rf4's (L5's clause); at 42 no extra deaths. This replaces v1's 'side effects within the margin' (review m5-2-4: the margin is a per-episode guard, not a read clause)
L6.episodes: 8 per world (fresh seeds, stage m5-heldout), replicates 0 and 1, as L5; arms: the selected candidate, rf4, entity_planner_buyahead_k4, entity_planner, all with MWWk
L6.gating_worlds: the loaded (rho > 0.28, not collapse) atlas v2 held-out worlds at 12 (deciding) and 42 (reported), as L5's; the other held-out worlds are played and reported
L6.ledger: key held-out/m5-producer; pending entry committed before launch
L6.selection: the seed whose candidate - rf4 is larger on the 12-producer loaded validation world mean (L5's comparison); seed 0 on a tie. Selecting on validation is fine: L6 reads held-out worlds on fresh seeds

floors.rule: per comparison: max(the atlas-spread floor at the read's counts, own 3 SE); own SE only with >= 2 paired observations on a world (the n = 1 rule); a gain at or below its floor is a tie

stock_heavy.role: reported only, never deciding; to the user
stock_heavy.rule: the selected theta's mean holding units per cycle > 1.5 x rf4's on the read's world-episodes

status: frozen before L2 (design D6); a real probe / train run refuses any other file

worlds.orderer_keys: DrawKey(world, episode, replicate); replicate 0 for bar / members, 0 and 1 for the monitor, 1..4 for the noise floor
